info.title: Arct Cloud API
info.description: Manage Arct Cloud servers over HTTPS with an API token. Errors return an `error` object with `code`, `message` and `details`.

get.description: Returns your account and the token that made the request.

schema.description: Filter by status. `provisioning` also matches failed builds.

schema.title: Datacenter

post.description: Creates a server in `datacenter` and charges the first billing period to your default card, else your first saved card. A saved card is required unless `payment_method` is `credit`, which pays from account credit. Poll `GET /servers/{server_id}` until `status` is `running`.

422.description: `validation_error` (see `details.fields`; also when neither `datacenter` nor `location` is sent), `datacenter_mismatch` (`datacenter` and `location` disagree).

500.description: `internal_error`. With `details.order_intent_id` the card was charged: don't retry, contact support.

get.description: Returns one server, with `login_user` filled in.

delete.description: Deletes the server and wipes its disk. Can't be undone. Renewals stop and paid time isn't refunded; backups are deleted, snapshots kept. With `at_period_end=true`, nothing renews and the server is deleted when its paid period ends (`cancel_at`); undo it with `POST /servers/{server_id}/cancel-deletion`.

parameters.name: at_period_end

schema.description: Delete when the paid period ends instead of now.
schema.title: At Period End

parameters.description: Delete when the paid period ends instead of now.

409.description: `conflict`: delete protection is on; a backup, snapshot or restore is running; the server is a pre-order; or it is already being deleted. With `at_period_end`, also: an unpaid invoice; a pending resize; a renewal in progress; or no paid time left. `node_maintenance`: the host is under maintenance (immediate delete only); see `Retry-After`.

503.description: `service_unavailable`: billing is unreachable (`at_period_end` only); retry later.

patch.description: Changes the hostname, delete protection or labels. Omitted fields keep their value.

409.description: `conflict`: the server is a pre-order, or `delete_protection: true` while a cancellation is scheduled.

get.description: Returns the locations you can order servers in.
Returns the datacenters you can order servers in. `location` is the location code without a number, as used by older requests.
Returns plans and monthly prices per location. Filter with `datacenter` or `location`. With `datacenter`, `in_stock` is that datacenter's stock.

get.description: Returns one invoice with its line items.
Returns your SSH keys, newest first.

post.description: Saves a public key to install on new and reinstalled servers.

delete.description: Deletes an SSH key. Servers that already have it keep it.

post.description: Starts a stopped server. Returns `202` while it boots.

409.description: `conflict`: the current state doesn't allow this. `node_maintenance`: the server's host is under maintenance; see `Retry-After` when the end is known.

post.description: Powers off a running server. Returns `202` while it stops.

409.description: `conflict`: the current state doesn't allow this. `node_maintenance`: the server's host is under maintenance; see `Retry-After` when the end is known.

post.description: Reboots a running server. Returns `202` while it restarts.

409.description: `conflict`: the current state doesn't allow this. `node_maintenance`: the server's host is under maintenance; see `Retry-After` when the end is known.

post.description: Wipes the disk and installs `image_id`. The server must be running or stopped. Returns `202` while it reinstalls.

409.description: `conflict`: delete protection is on; the server isn't running or stopped; or it is suspended or a pre-order. `node_maintenance`: the host is under maintenance; see `Retry-After`.

post.description: Keeps a server scheduled with `DELETE /servers/{server_id}?at_period_end=true`; it renews as before and `cancel_at` becomes null. A server with nothing scheduled is returned unchanged.

409.description: `conflict`: the server is already being deleted or its period has ended; the subscription has ended; or the server is a pre-order.

get.description: Returns the plans this server can resize to, with `amount_due_today` for each.

post.description: Moves a stopped server to a bigger plan and charges the prorated difference to the server's billing card, else your default card, or to account credit with `payment_method: credit`. Returns `200` when paid, `202` while the payment processes. Start the server afterwards.

202.description: Payment still processing; `GET /servers/{server_id}/resize-options` shows it in `pending_resize`.

get.description: Returns your account credit transactions, newest first.

post.description: Pays a pending invoice in full from account credit and returns the paid invoice. Add credit in the dashboard under Billing > Account credits.

400.description: `credit_unavailable`, `invoice_not_payable` (not pending, or a resize invoice: resize with credit).

402.description: `insufficient_credit`; `details.shortfall` is the USD missing. Nothing charged.

409.description: `payment_in_progress`: a card payment for this invoice is still running.

credit_autopay.title: Credit Autopay
credit_autopay.description: True if account credit pays invoices on their due date.

token.description: The token that made this request.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: RFC 1123 label. A name used by your servers or open orders returns `409 hostname_taken`.

datacenter.title: Datacenter
datacenter.description: Datacenter code: the location code plus a number, such as `ams1`. From `GET /datacenters`, any case.

location.title: Location
location.description: Deprecated. Location code without a number, such as `ams`. Still accepted: the server goes to the location's default datacenter for the plan's tier. Use `datacenter`.

image_id.title: Image Id
image_id.description: Image ID from `GET /images` for the same location.

ssh_key_ids.title: Ssh Key Ids
ssh_key_ids.description: IDs of your SSH keys to install. Omit for all saved keys (a password if none); send `[]` for a password. Ignored for Windows images.

enable_backups.title: Enable Backups
enable_backups.description: True adds automatic backups for 20% of the plan price, where `backups_available` is true.

payment_method.title: Payment Method
payment_method.description: `card` charges a saved card; `credit` pays from account credit and needs no card.

server.description: Null until the server is recorded.

password.title: Password
password.description: Login password for `server.login_user`. Null when SSH keys are installed; also null at pre-order locations or for a delayed build, and then emailed. Shown only here and in the email. If support retries the build or Windows password setup fails, follow the email.

amount.title: Amount
amount.description: Signed, in USD: positive adds credit, negative spends or removes it.

balance_after.title: Balance After
balance_after.description: Your account credit right after this entry, in USD.

code.title: Code
code.description: Datacenter code: the location code plus a number, such as `ams1`.

location.title: Location
location.description: Location code without a number, such as `ams`.

tiers.title: Tiers
tiers.description: Plan tiers you can order in this datacenter.

id.title: Id
id.description: Image ID. IDs differ per location.

allowed_plans.title: Allowed Plans
allowed_plans.description: Plan slugs allowed; empty means every plan.

datacenters.title: Datacenters
datacenters.description: Datacenter codes in this location, such as `ams1`.

status.title: Status
status.description: `paid` once charged; `completed` once the server is ready.

payment_method.title: Payment Method
payment_method.description: `credit` pays the full total from account credit.

datacenters.title: Datacenters
datacenters.description: Datacenters you can order this plan in, such as `ams1`.

price_monthly.title: Price Monthly
price_monthly.description: Monthly price at this location, in USD.

password.title: Password
password.description: Login password for `server.login_user`, or null when SSH keys are installed. Shown only here and in the email. If support retries the build or Windows password setup fails, follow the email. The old password stops working.

days_left.title: Days Left
days_left.description: Days left in the billing period.

payment_methods.title: Payment Methods
payment_methods.description: How a resize can be paid.

price_period.title: Price Period
price_period.description: Price per billing period, promo included, in USD.

price_period_list.title: Price Period List
price_period_list.description: Price per billing period before promo, in USD.

eligible.title: Eligible
eligible.description: True if the server can move to this plan.

ResizePromo.title: ResizePromo
ResizePromo.description: The recurring promo code in effect on the server; it follows the server onto the new plan.

restart_required.title: Restart Required
restart_required.description: True if the server must be started to use the new size.

expected_amount.title: Expected Amount
expected_amount.description: The quoted `amount_due_today`; a changed price returns `409 price_changed`. Omit to accept the current price.

payment_method.title: Payment Method
payment_method.description: `card` charges a saved card; `credit` pays from account credit and needs no card.

datacenter.title: Datacenter
datacenter.description: Datacenter code, such as `fra1`, or null if the host has none.

ipv4.title: Ipv4
ipv4.description: Null until the server is set up.

ipv6.title: Ipv6
ipv6.description: IPv6 address, or null if none is assigned.

login_user.title: Login User
login_user.description: OS user to sign in as. Null in list responses.

price.title: Price
price.description: Price per billing period, in USD.

cancel_at.title: Cancel At
cancel_at.description: Date a scheduled cancellation takes effect, or null if none.

image_id.title: Image Id
image_id.description: Image ID from `GET /images`, for the server's location and plan.

ssh_key_ids.title: Ssh Key Ids
ssh_key_ids.description: IDs of your SSH keys to install. Omit for all saved keys (a password if none); send `[]` for a password. Ignored for Windows images.

hostname.title: Hostname
hostname.description: Name shown in Arct. The OS hostname changes only on reinstall.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: Replaces all labels: up to 10, each 1 to 63 letters, digits or `-`, starting with a letter or digit. Stored lowercase.

public_key.title: Public Key
public_key.description: One OpenSSH public key line. Types: `ssh-ed25519`, `ssh-rsa`, `ecdsa-sha2-nistp256/384/521`, `ssh-dss`, `sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com`, `sk-ecdsa-sha2-nistp256@openssh.com`.

SshKeyCreate.title: SshKeyCreate
SshKeyCreate.description: An SSH public key to save.

UnpaidInvoice.title: UnpaidInvoice
UnpaidInvoice.description: A renewal invoice that must be paid before the server can be resized.

bearerAuth.description: API token from Dashboard > Settings > API Tokens.
